_source: BUG-696 (2026-11-09): an author-year citation that names its source in another spelling than the reference entry was left without an entry. Measured on the stored dev theses: DESTAMP cites 'Xiongbin (2017)' for the entry 'Xiong-Bin, W. et al. (2017)' and 'Statista Research Department (2023)' for 'Statista. (2023)'; two blind raters judged both the same work. Only a citation the main matching left without an entry is considered, only in a document where the main matching linked something, and only when exactly one same-year entry fits it by name.
_fold_note: Characters dropped before two names are compared: 'Xiong-Bin' and 'Xiongbin' are one name.
_organisation_note: An organisation written in a short and a long form ('Statista', 'Statista Research Department'): one name's words begin the other's, and the longer name carries an organisation word (the reference metadata's corporate_author_words), so two people such as 'Garcia' and 'Garcia Lopez M.' never match. Not when the acronym table gives the short form to another body ('NASA'). Only for an entry nothing else cites, and only when the citing sentence carries the entry's title: at least title_evidence_min_words of its title words and at least title_evidence_min_share of them, not counting words that belong to either name.
